text: This report seeks the Board's approval to award an asset management contract to develop a comprehensive Asset Management Program at the Toronto Parking Authority. Implementing Asset Management aligns with ISO 55000 standards and aims to maximize asset value through consistent maintenance practices. Moreover, a comprehensive Asset Management Program directly reflects Toronto Parking Authority's vision to be the best provider of parking, bike share, and last-mile mobility experiences, making this proposal a natural fit for our organization. As identified in Toronto Parking Authority's Enterprise Risk Management program, aging infrastructure, equipment, and technology pose significant risks. The Asset Management Program is crucial to managing assets effectively, modernizing equipment, and ensuring sustained operational quality. Compliance with Ontario Regulation 588/17 mandates…

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Authorized the President, Toronto Parking Authority, to award the 2024-CS-VAR-2030.30 - Asset Management Implementation Project to WSP Canada Inc., meeting all specifications in conformance with the request for proposal requirements, in the amount of $2,881,380 inclusive of contingency but excluding HST.
